status: Schematic single-patient ICU asset catalog; footprints are planning approximations, not manufacturer data.
facing_convention: At rotation_deg 0 an asset's FRONT is its SOUTH edge (-y side). Wall-anchored assets set rotation_deg by wall so the front turns into the room: N->0, S->180, E->270, W->90. On E/W walls this rotation swaps the placed footprint (a 6x2 casework places as 2x6). The 2D symbols (web/public/assets/2d) and 3D GLBs (web/public/assets/3d) are authored front-south to match; icu_bed is exempt (its head/foot axis is set by layout logic, not this rule).

assets.label: ICU Bed
assets.notes: Head short side faces the headwall; long axis runs head to foot.

assets.label: Ceiling Boom
assets.notes: Two booms flank the bed head on opposite sides of the bed long axis.

assets.label: Patient Monitor
assets.notes: Wall or headwall mounted on the equipment side near the bed head.

assets.label: IV Pole
assets.notes: Mobile; parked near the bed head, may sit inside a bed side clearance.

assets.label: Visitor Chair
assets.notes: Sits on the visitor side, opposite the equipment side.

assets.label: Casework / Supply Cabinet
assets.notes: Wall run; not on the headwall and clear of the door swing.

assets.label: Handwash Sink
assets.notes: Wall mounted within reach of the room entry door.

assets.label: Overbed Table
assets.notes: Mobile; parked beside the bed, may sit inside a bed side clearance.
